Under the agreement, the companies will jointly develop and promote intelligent equipment solutions covering 24 automotive aftermarket processes.

Lianhe Sowell, a holding company focused on industrial machine vision products and solutions in China, will supply complete intelligent equipment sets. Kumquat will provide related automotive parts and use its domestic distribution network to promote the solutions.
The companies also plan to pursue overseas opportunities, with Kumquat Technology handling market development and operations and Lianhe Sowell providing products and technical support.
The partnership will additionally promote Kumquat Technology’s automotive aftermarket parts through Lianhe Sowell’s industry customer network.

children: LHSW Technical Setup Amid Mixed Market Breadth

With markets open, the broader backdrop is mixed: the Nasdaq is up 0.46% while the Dow is down 0.45%, and market breadth is positive with eight sectors advancing versus 3 declining (advance/decline ratio: 2.7). That "risk-on but selective" tone can amplify single-stock moves when a small-cap name drops fresh partnership news.
LHSW Outperforms Technology Sector After Partnership News

LHSW is massively outperforming its sector today, up 124.02% versus a 0.25% gain for Technology—an outperformance of 123.77 percentage points. That kind of gap usually signals traders are reacting to a specific headline rather than a broad sector bid.

Technology is currently the No. 6 performer out of 11 sectors (mid-tier), with leadership coming from Consumer Staples (+1.04%), Materials (+0.98%), and Healthcare (+0.70%). Over the past 30 days the sector is up 8.46% (and up 6.69% over 90 days), so today’s move in LHSW looks less like "sector momentum" and more like a one-stock repricing on the cooperation announcement.
